children: Navitas Semiconductor USA entered into a patent assignment agreement to acquire patents and patent applications from Longitude Flash Memory Solutions and Longitude Licensing. The deal requires a $5 million upfront payment, a potential additional $5 million upon specified litigation outcomes, and a 1.5% share of gross revenue from monetizing the patents; the assignors also terminated related intercompany licenses and agreements.
